results.title: Shure to unveil IntelliMix Bar Pro in India at InfoComm
results.description: India's growing demand for connected classrooms and meeting rooms is putting clearer speech and tighter platform integration at a premium.

results.title: West Bengal Journalist Pension: Major Benefits Announced for Journalists
results.description: West Bengal Journalist Pension is set to undergo a major expansion, with Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announcing new benefits for journalists across the state.

results.title: Congress delegation meets MP Governor, seeks prosecution sanction against Minister Vijay Shah
results.description: A Congress delegation led by MP Leader of Opposition Umang Singhar met Governor Mangubhai Patel, seeking prosecution sanction against Minister Vijay Shah over his controversial remarks about Colonel Sofiya Qureshi. The demand comes after the Governor approved the Cabinet’s decision denying sanction.

results.title: Telangana BJP Chief N Ramchander Rao detained, put under house arrest
results.description: Telangana BJP president N Ramchander Rao was detained by police after being placed under house arrest to prevent him from visiting Nalgonda. He called the situation 'worst undemocratic' and blamed rising tensions with the ruling Congress party.

results.title: Delhi HC slams police for 'pick and choose' arrests in child case
results.description: The Delhi High Court slammed the police for 'selective arrests' in a child trafficking case, calling the probe 'highly appalling' as the infant remains unrecovered. The court dismissed an accused's bail plea, citing the gravity of the offence.
